name: Unknown replication inventory targets
kql:
DCReplicationData_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= _WindowStart and TimeGenerated < _WindowEnd
| extend Target = tolower(trim_end(@"\.+", trim(@"\s+", tostring(DestDSA))))
| where isnotempty(Target) and Target !in~ ("<EMPTY_VALUE>", "unknown", "null", "n/a", "-")
| where Target !in~ (_InventoryComputers)
| summarize count() by Target
